name: What is the difference between a barndominium shell and a turnkey build?
description: A shell provides only the exterior weather-tight structure, whereas a turnkey build delivers a finished, move-in-ready home complete with interior living spaces

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a barndominium shell and a turnkey build?

acceptedAnswer.text: A barndominium shell provides only the structural envelope, leaving the interior completely open, while a turnkey build delivers a fully finished, move-in-ready residence. Opting for a shell gives buyers flexible interior layouts and lower upfront expenses, but requires managing subcontractors for plumbing, electrical, insulation, and interior walls later. A turnkey contract costs more upfront but provides completed living spaces under a single management scope.
